notes.title: Our first playtest is complete – Thank You, Luminas Community!
notes.notes: [p]Our very first [i]Luminas: Parasite Reign[/i] playtest has officially wrapped up, and we couldn’t be more grateful to every single one of you who jumped in, tested, and shared feedback. More than 200 players signed up for the playtest, giving us the motivation to keep expanding and improving the game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s Next?[/b][/p][p]We’re already hard at work building the [b]next wave of content[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]A completed (more polish and chaos) 25minute map with 4 to 5 bosses (included at the playtest)[/p][/*][*][p]More [b]theme maps[/b] to have fun[/p][/*][*][p]Unique [b]skill trees for each Lumina[/b], letting you build wildly different strategies.[/p][/*][/list][p]Our goal is to deliver a [b]more complete and exciting version[/b] of [i]Luminas: Parasite Reign[/i] for Early Access, and maybe a [b]second playtest[/b] may be on the way 👀[/p][p][/p][p][b]Got Feedback to Share?[/b][/p][p]If you played the test or just want to help us shape the future of [i]the game[/i], we’d love to hear your thoughts completing this form 👉 [url="https://forms.gle/Fuw2szdZtfETcHcy6"]Give Feedback Here[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again![/p][p]Team Luminas: Parasite Reign[/p]
